channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: JetBlue cancels Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters and adopters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent artificial intelligence from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible starting Wednesday night to prevent teams from using artificial intelligence to help make in-game decisions.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
item.description: Argentina scored two late goals to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals and advance to Sunday's final against Spain.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final with Trump attending trophy presentation
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies are implementing a security plan two years in the making for Sunday's World Cup final in New Jersey, with President Trump attending the trophy presentation.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with victory over France
item.description: Spain defeated France 2-0 to advance to the World Cup final, where they will face Argentina on Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: Flip City Gym and Cheer gymnasts qualify for Junior Olympics with top 15 national finish
item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer qualified for the Junior Olympics after securing a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month. item.title: Florida voter data highlighted in declassified intelligence reports as Trump renews election security push
item.description: President Donald Trump renewed debate over election security during his Thursday national address, while newly released intelligence records put a spotlight on publicly available Florida voter-registration data. item.title: Jury orders Florida Rep. Fabian Basabe to pay $450,000 in sexual harassment, battery case
item.description: A Leon County jury found Republican state Rep. Fabian Basabe liable for sexual harassment, battery and defamation, ordering him to pay $450,000 to former legislative aide Nicolas Frevola, former intern Jacob Cutbirth and Frevola's mother.

item.title: Alex Vindman raises $8.5 million for Florida Senate race, expanding fundraising lead
item.description: Retired Army Lt. Alex Vindman tightened his grip on the Democratic money lead during the second quarter, raising $8.5 million and pushing his total receipts above $16 million in the race for Florida's U.S. Senate seat.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels low-altitude Pensacola beach flyover as safety scrutiny mounts
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is encouraging low-altitude military flyovers after a Blue Angels fighter jet buzzed a crowded Pensacola beach Wednesday, flying so low that chairs and tents went flying and sand kicked up.

item.title: Florida gubernatorial candidate James Fishback faces residency challenge in court
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will defend his eligibility to remain in the primary as opponent Lt. Jay Collins argues that records showing Fishback lived and voted in Washington, D.C., mean he does not satisfy Florida's seven-year residency requirement for governor.

item.title: Florida Rep. Angie Nixon to stand trial in September on charges stemming from Capitol sit-in
item.description: Democratic state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May sit-in outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office, where she and other protesters objected to Florida's newly approved congressional map.

item.title: Pensacola beachgoer calls Blue Angels low flyover 'once-in-a-lifetime experience' as military reviews safety
item.description: Florida beachgoer Alexandra Belcher called the Blue Angels flyover a once-in-a-lifetime experience, saying she didn't realize how close the jet was until everyone around her reacted.
